notes: Send x-waldo-app-contract: controls=9 to receive revision and revised_at on a day card; a build below 9 never receives them.

Waldo may revise a day card it already delivered when the owner's day changes (a meeting moves, a cancellation frees time). A revision is a new Main chat row; the original row stays in the chat and in day history.

revision counts the revisions delivered today (1 for the first). revised_at is when the latest one was delivered, epoch ms. Show it as "updated HH:MM" in the owner's zone. Both are present or both absent.

At controls=9 a revised card's latest names its newest revision's row, so the excerpt is the revised text. When that revision reached the owner outside the app (iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram), latest is null: show the revision and its time without words. Below 9 latest stays the original delivery.
A push with data.trigger "update" says the day changed. It may carry card_ref ("card:brief", "card:midday" or "card:close"): open that card. Without card_ref, open Main chat.

latest.excerpt: Update to your Brief: the 15:00 sync moved to 17:00, so the afternoon is free until then.
